model_policy: Original Q6_K and original DFlash weights, BF16 unquantized KV, FP32 state, actual44GiB,32GiB internal disk cache. No model/weight/precision/context changes. Local branch only.
workloads: Original eight instruction forks plus four complete two-turn code/tool tasks per cohort;16requests. First4cohorts original fixture order, last4reverse. Same neutral INTERNAL seed cloned fresh per phase. All256 responses retained, including failures and changed outputs. Startup and prior neutral seed preparation excluded; firstnew8K reference, captures/restores, and residual newpolicy backup maintenance included.

selection.tie_within_0.5_percentage_points: Prefer joint without offload if retention does not reduce recomputation or tail latency. No mandatory all24 identical-output gate; full native raw-logit/GDN exactness and unchanged behavior oracles remain required.

interpretation: Prospectively frozen new factorial experiment, not a reclassification of prior rejected data. Overall latency includes changed outputs and known model failures. Same-output/cache-count strata are diagnostics, never replacements for complete-workflow acceptance. Do not sum historical component gains.
cache_policy: Only NEW experiment scratch cohort caches are removed after native unload and full SHA256/index preservation. Original production cache, canonical seeds, historical experiments, SSD archives, every response/artifact/script retained. No external I/O during timed inference.
